data.body: Converted bug -> epic (user-directed, 2026-06-05). Rationale: the code symptom (hardcoded 1000-issue ACLI ceiling) was already remediated out-of-band — fetcher.py now uses a split active/Done-recent JQL with an empirically-cited 1,200 ceiling (commit 01d709a5a7). The remaining work is the planning/sprint-process change this ticket always described and which was never made: (1) operational constants carry a citation OR a planning-time measurement; (2) surfaced in brainstorm tradeoff-research ('is this value verified against the deployment environment?'); (3) REPLAN_ESCALATE when implementation gap-analysis finds the planned detection mechanism absent; (4) a completion-verifier validation-class rubric category ('value is calibrated to environment'); (5) no silent deferral to a phantom operator-review step. Companion meta-bugs 5f2a / 1761 should inform the same retrospective. Title updated to reflect remaining scope. Next step: /dso:brainstorm to decompose into stories.
